issues.detail: The Greek 'παισιν αυτου' refers to his 'children' (sons/offspring), but the Vietnamese 'đầy tớ' means 'servants'. This changes the relationship of the people being addressed.
The Vietnamese adds the word 'mới' (new) before 'hành động' (acting/working), which is not present in the Greek text ('αι δυναμεις ενεργουσιν').
